lead: `owners.py` reads a gap item as running to the end of the module doc, so a paragraph *after* the numbered list makes the owner tag "not the item's last line".
body: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/process.rs` kept its `**What it spends:**` paragraph inside `# Known gaps`, so the tag appended to item 1 left the gate red with a message that reads like a formatting typo in the tag itself. Move the trailing paragraph above the `# Known gaps` heading — where the rest of the crate already has it — rather than moving the tag down past prose it does not belong to.

until.arg: tools/owners.py:the owner tag is not the item's last line
